steps.clue: Restore power, activate the Particle Accelerator and build Pack-a-Punch in the Dark Aether.
Build the Aetherscope, deliver Vogel’s diary to the three spectral reflections and enter the password.
Obtain the D.I.E. Shockwave and use its four elemental upgrades on the decontamination chamber.
Witness the Medical Bay reflection and recover the Dark Aether Wrench.
Repair the tank and use it to recover the Decontamination Agent.
Trap both Megaton halves inside the chamber and begin the purification process.
Enter the Dark Aether and recover Orlov’s family photograph.
Defend Orlov as he shuts down the Particle Accelerator.
Escape Projekt Endstation while avoiding the electrical surges, then board the exfil helicopter.
